title: Contrast MR-Based Radiomics and Machine Learning Analysis to Assess Clinical Outcomes following Liver Resection in Colorectal Liver Metastases: A Preliminary Study
summary: Contrast-MRI radiomic features and machine-learning models were evaluated against post-resection outcomes in a preliminary colorectal-liver-metastasis cohort. Reported associations and prediction are limited by the preliminary cohort and validation design.
ai_technology: Radiomic features from contrast MRI are modeled against post-resection outcomes in colorectal liver metastases.
organization: Division of Radiology, Istituto Nazionale Tumori IRCCS Fondazione Pascale-IRCCS di Napoli, 80131 Naples, Italy

evidence.tested: Results reports outcome associations/prediction in a preliminary cohort; limited validation.
evidence.unknown: The source describes a preliminary cohort and limited validation; broader prognostic performance was not established.
evidence.ai_role: Radiomic features from contrast MRI are modeled against post-resection outcomes in colorectal liver metastases.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
